_doc: Furniture at real scale for the interiors in place, made by tools/make_muebles.py (kit/muebles/<id>.gltf, outside git; regenerate with `blender -b --python tools/make_muebles.py`). size = [x, z depth, height] in m; box = [x0, z0, x1, z1], its plan bounds round its origin; front = +z in Godot, base on the floor, centred on its footprint; what stands against a wall has its back at -z. tiles = footprint in 1 m tiles [x, z]; use = where it is used from (front, sides, any, none); blocks = it takes its tiles (the real blocking is by its size, InteriorBuilder._block_real); seat_h / top_h = heights of the seat and of the top; lie = where a sleeper lies; hang = it hangs on the wall behind it and hides when that wall is lowered; fire = where its light goes; ids = the GuildMaster prop ids it stands for in a compact interior. Local points are Godot's (x, y up, z front).
